text: The First Tale...
Warm sunlight shone down in a gentle breeze.
Carried on that breeze came the sound of a lute...
In the shade of a tree at the edge of town, an old bard spoke softly to the folk.
You drew near and joined the crowd.
To the strains of the lute, the bard quietly began:
The First Tale. It happened long ago...
In those days, this land was still called Sosaria, divided and ruled by many rival lords.
Our ancestors deeply loved this soil, tilling it, living, and dying here.
Many lived in happiness while others fell in battle.
Though greedy lords quarreled endlessly, peaceful days mostly endured.
Yet when was it that evil hands brought
calamity...?
Raining down upon our fair and bountiful land of Sosaria, a realm once blessed with peace...
Through endless disasters, Sosaria's villages were trampled by dread monsters, leaving many in ruin.
All of this was wrought by the rise of Mondain, a name still spoken only with dread and loathing.
Beasts loosed by Mondain raided castles and burned towns. Folk fled in terror while lords defended their own keeps.
Yet among them stood one alone... a young, wise king,
Lord British, who yearned for peace and unity across all of Sosaria...
A hero was summoned by the king and heeded his call.
Chosen by destiny, the hero sets forth now to slay the evil Mondain!
